selection_rule: For each available P-model outcome stratum in the 128-case XAI sample, select the case with both proposed Grad-CAM and proposed Guided Grad-CAM pointing inside lung, then largest minimum proposed LRR+ across the two methods, then largest total proposed-minus-control LRR+ delta.
note: No FN stratum was present for the proposed models in seed 3407 XAI sample.
